translate.label: Translate
translate.subject: Translate: English or Thai is found by itself. Whatever you type, the app reads which language it is from the letters: more Thai letters than English ones is Thai (the English comes out), else English (the Thai comes out), so one Thai word in an English line ("I want to eat ข้าว") no longer turns the whole line round; numbers alone, or as many of each, go the way the button is set. After each translation the ไทย / EN button, the box's words and the widget's bar follow what you typed, and the keyboard is asked for that language the next time the box opens (not mid-word, which would break the typing). javacheck 35/35 (2 new tests); 2 mutants red (any Thai letter = Thai, a tie ignoring the button). Asked: "Can translate auto detect if it's eng or Thai please".

nudge.label: Nudge
nudge.subject: Nudge: seven fixes from a review of the phone side. A task that came before notifications were allowed (Android 13+ starts with them off) was counted as nudged and never shown; now it rings as soon as they are allowed, also from Settings (the app nudges again on every return). Nudges are alarm clocks, so every 5 minutes holds while the phone dozes (the other kind is let through only every ~9 minutes). An answer from the Pi older than a tick just sent no longer brings the ticked task back. Done on a notification can no longer hold Android's receiver past its limit. A place allowed in Settings is watched at once. A second Save where I am is no longer cut short by the first one's timeout. A send that keeps failing waits longer each time, up to 2 minutes, instead of every 15 s for ever. Proof: compiles against android.jar, unit tests 13/13, the two-phone drive passes.
